target_choice_explanations.B: eDiscovery is the right tool for legal content search and export, but the stem asks for an administrative activity trail rather than a legal production set.

revisions.target_general_explanation: Microsoft Purview Audit records supported user and administrator activities so investigators can determine who performed an action and when it occurred. eDiscovery is used to search, review, and export content for legal matters instead.

revisions.target_general_explanation: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery covers the legal-case workflow for preserving, searching, reviewing, and exporting relevant Microsoft 365 content. After a hold is in place, the continued search, review, and export work remains an eDiscovery function.
